<input
          ref={fileInput}
          type="file"
          accept=".json,.html,.htm"
          aria-label="导入 SAP 文件"
          hidden
          onChange={(event) => {
            const file = event.target.files?.[0];
            event.target.value = "";
            if (file) void readFile(file);
          }}
        />

<input
              // accept="image/*"
              accept={uploadOptions.acceptMimes.join(",") || "image/*"}
              multiple={uploadOptions.multiple}
              onChange={handleFile}
              ref={fileInput}
              style={{ display: "none" }}
              type="file"
            />

<button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label='Dismiss'
          data-slot='alert-close'
          className={cn('richtext-group richtext-size-4 richtext-shrink-0 richtext-cursor-pointer')}
        >

<Comp
      ref={ref}
      data-slot='button'
      className={cn(
        buttonVariants({
          variant,
          size,
          radius,
          appearance,
          mode,
          autoHeight,
          placeholder,
          underlined,
          underline,
          className,
        }),
        asChild && props.disabled && 'richtext-pointer-events-none richtext-opacity-50'
      )}
      {...(selected && { 'data-state': 'open' })}
      {...props}
    />

<Comp
      ref={ref}
      data-slot='input'
      type={type}
      className={cn(inputVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />

<textarea
      ref={ref}
      data-slot='textarea'
      className={cn(textareaVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
<input hidden onChange={handleFile} ref={$upload} type="file" />

<span
                  className={`image-resizer__handler image-resizer__handler--${direction}`}
                  key={`image-dir-${direction}`}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => onMouseDown(e, direction)}
                >

<input
        accept={uploadOptions?.acceptMimes?.join(",") || "image/*"}
        multiple={false} // TODO No sense unless doing queue processing
        onChange={handleFile}
        ref={fileInput}
        style={{ display: "none" }}
        type="file"
      />

<span
                  className={`image-resizer__handler image-resizer__handler--${direction}`}
                  key={`image-dir-${direction}`}
                  onPointerCancel={(e) => finishResize(e, false)}
                  onPointerDown={(e) => onPointerDown(e, direction)}
                  onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
                  onPointerUp={(e) => finishResize(e, true)}
                >

<input
              // accept="image/*"
              accept={uploadOptions.acceptMimes.join(",") || "image/*"}
              multiple={uploadOptions.multiple}
              onChange={handleFile}
              ref={fileInput}
              style={{ display: "none" }}
              type="file"
            />

<span
                  className={`image-resizer__handler image-resizer__handler--${direction}`}
                  key={`image-dir-${direction}`}
                  onPointerCancel={(e) => finishResize(e, false)}
                  onPointerDown={(e) => onPointerDown(e, direction)}
                  onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
                  onPointerUp={(e) => finishResize(e, true)}
                >

<input
        accept='.docx'
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        ref={fileInput}
        type='file'
        style={{
          display: 'none',
        }}
      />

<span
                  className={`image-resizer__handler image-resizer__handler--${direction}`}
                  key={`image-dir-${direction}`}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => onMouseDown(e, direction)}
                >

<div
            className="richtext-flex richtext-flex-col richtext-flex-wrap richtext-justify-between richtext-gap-1"
            onPointerCancel={onPointerCancel}
            onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
            onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
            onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
            style={{ touchAction: "none" }}
          >

<input
        accept={
          (uploadOptions.acceptMimes ?? DEFAULT_VIDEO_OPTIONS.acceptMimes).join(',') || 'video/*'
        }
        multiple={uploadOptions.multiple ?? DEFAULT_VIDEO_OPTIONS.multiple}
        onChange={handleFile}
        ref={fileInput}
        type='file'
        style={{
          display: 'none',
        }}
      />
